patches.reason: Remove Electron-only dev tooling (electron, @lydell/node-pty, devtools-protocol) from devDependencies. They are used only by gui-extensions' own tests/typecheck, and electron's postinstall pulls ~110MB of binaries that the web build never needs.
patches.verification: V2 (bun run build:web) succeeds without the removed devDependencies.

patches.reason: Memory-only credentials: the encode (write) path of the server persistence schema drops `password`, so no persistent backend (web localStorage, desktop storage, drafts) ever receives one. Decoding still tolerates stored passwords from legacy files; a missing password reaches the existing authentication-failure path. Keystore persistence is owned by mobile issue #4. The embedded marker string 'mobile(M-002): password stripped at encode (memory-only)' survives minification and anchors V-cred dist verification.
patches.verification: V-cred: (a) encode-path strip present in source with marker; (b) marker string found in built dist assets; semantic probe of the codec against effect@4.0.1 confirmed strip on encode, tolerance on decode.

patches.reason: Strip the three workspace references that dangle after closure acquisition (their targets are excluded packages): client devDependency @opencode/httpapi-codegen (generated code is committed), plugin devDependency+peerDependency+peerDependenciesMeta @opencode/theme (not in the runtime closure), ai devDependency @opencode/http-recorder (test recording tool). Bun 1.4.2 hard-errors on dangling workspace devDependencies and unsatisfied workspace peerDependencies.
patches.verification: V1 (bun install) succeeds and V3(b) workspace-reference scan reports zero dangling refs.
